paragraphs.text: If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
paragraphs.original: Ἐὰν ταῖς γλώσσαις τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαλῶ καὶ τῶν ἀγγέλων, ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω, γέγονα χαλκὸς ἠχῶν ἢ κύμβαλον ἀλαλάζον.
paragraphs.translit: Ean tais glōssais tōn anthrōpōn lalō kai tōn angelōn, agapēn de mē echō, gegona chalkos ēchōn ē kymbalon alalazon.

paragraphs.text: And if I have [the gift of] prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἔχω προφητείαν καὶ εἰδῶ τὰ μυστήρια πάντα καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γνῶσιν, ⸄καὶ ἐὰν⸅ ἔχω πᾶσαν τὴν πίστιν ὥστε ὄρη μεθιστάναι, ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω, οὐθέν εἰμι.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean echō prophēteian kai eidō ta mystēria panta kai pasan tēn gnōsin, ⸄kai ean⸅ echō pasan tēn pistin hōste orē methistanai, agapēn de mē echō, outhen eimi.

paragraphs.text: And if I bestow all my goods to feed [the poor], and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profiteth me nothing.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν ψωμίσω πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντά μου, ⸄καὶ ἐὰν⸅ παραδῶ τὸ σῶμά μου, ἵνα καυθήσομαι, ἀγάπην δὲ μὴ ἔχω, οὐδὲν ὠφελοῦμαι.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean psōmisō panta ta hyparchonta mou, ⸄kai ean⸅ paradō to sōma mou, hina kauthēsomai, agapēn de mē echō, ouden ōpheloumai.

paragraphs.text: Love suffereth long, [and] is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
paragraphs.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη μακροθυμεῖ, χρηστεύεται ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐ ζηλοῖ ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐ περπερεύεται, οὐ φυσιοῦται,
paragraphs.translit: Hē agapē makrothymei, chrēsteuetai hē agapē, ou zēloi hē agapē, ou perpereuetai, ou physioutai,

paragraphs.text: doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not its own, is not provoked, taketh not account of evil;
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἀσχημονεῖ, οὐ ζητεῖ τὰ ἑαυτῆς, οὐ παροξύνεται, οὐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν,
paragraphs.translit: ouk aschēmonei, ou zētei ta heautēs, ou paroxynetai, ou logizetai to kakon,

paragraphs.text: rejoiceth not in unrighteousness, but rejoiceth with the truth;
paragraphs.original: οὐ χαίρει ἐπὶ τῇ ἀδικίᾳ, συγχαίρει δὲ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ·
paragraphs.translit: ou chairei epi tē adikia, synchairei de tē alētheia·

paragraphs.text: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
paragraphs.original: πάντα στέγει, πάντα πιστεύει, πάντα ἐλπίζει, πάντα ὑπομένει.
paragraphs.translit: panta stegei, panta pisteuei, panta elpizei, panta hypomenei.

paragraphs.text: Love never faileth: but whether [there be] prophecies, they shall be done away; whether [there be] tongues, they shall cease; whether [there be] knowledge, it shall be done away.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη οὐδέποτε πίπτει. εἴτε δὲ προφητεῖαι, καταργηθήσονται· εἴτε γλῶσσαι, παύσονται· εἴτε γνῶσις, καταργηθήσεται.
paragraphs.translit: Hē agapē oudepote piptei. eite de prophēteiai, katargēthēsontai· eite glōssai, pausontai· eite gnōsis, katargēthēsetai.

paragraphs.text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;
paragraphs.original: ἐκ μέρους γὰρ γινώσκομεν καὶ ἐκ μέρους προφητεύομεν·
paragraphs.translit: ek merous gar ginōskomen kai ek merous prophēteuomen·

paragraphs.text: but when that which is perfect is come, that which is in part shall be done away.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ τὸ τέλειον, τὸ ἐκ μέρους καταργηθήσεται.
paragraphs.translit: hotan de elthē to teleion, to ek merous katargēthēsetai.

paragraphs.text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child: now that I am become a man, I have put away childish things.
paragraphs.original: ὅτε ἤμην νήπιος, ἐλάλουν ὡς νήπιος, ἐφρόνουν ὡς νήπιος, ἐλογιζόμην ὡς νήπιος· ὅτε γέγονα ἀνήρ, κατήργηκα τὰ τοῦ νηπίου.
paragraphs.translit: hote ēmēn nēpios, elaloun hōs nēpios, ephronoun hōs nēpios, elogizomēn hōs nēpios· hote gegona anēr, katērgēka ta tou nēpiou.

paragraphs.text: For now we see in a mirror, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know fully even as also I was fully known.
paragraphs.original: βλέπομεν γὰρ ἄρτι διʼ ἐσόπτρου ἐν αἰνίγματι, τότε δὲ πρόσωπον πρὸς πρόσωπον· ἄρτι γινώσκω ἐκ μέρους, τότε δὲ ἐπιγνώσομαι καθὼς καὶ ἐπεγνώσθην.
paragraphs.translit: blepomen gar arti diʼ esoptrou en ainigmati, tote de prosōpon pros prosōpon· arti ginōskō ek merous, tote de epignōsomai kathōs kai epegnōsthēn.

paragraphs.text: But now abideth faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ μένει πίστις, ἐλπίς, ἀγάπη· τὰ τρία ταῦτα, μείζων δὲ τούτων ἡ ἀγάπη.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de menei pistis, elpis, agapē· ta tria tauta, meizōn de toutōn hē agapē.
